expectation: CAIX-type carbonic anhydrase should be membranous or cytoplasmic in a subset of epithelial or tumour cells, often in hypoxic nests. It should be patchy between regions and ROIs, with unstained stroma and lymphocytes.
observed: A: strong signal in only a few ROIs. One has a saturated block at the border, and others show web-like or banded yellow around cell clusters. Most ROIs are near-empty. B/C: faint grain and haze tracking nuclear density, with no discrete cells. D: saturated amorphous yellow with no cell outlines, at an image edge.
why: Patchy ROI-restricted network-like signal fits a heterogeneous membranous marker, but the typical fields show only haze and the brightest spot looks like an edge artefact.
